name: gpui-native-monorepo
description: Framework-neutral GPU-accelerated UI runtime for Zed's GPUI

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:adapters && bun --filter "@gpui-*/example-*" build
scripts.build:binaries: bun run build:native && bun run build:adapters && bun --filter "@gpui-*/example-*" build:binary
scripts.bench: bun run scripts/bench-hot-paths.mts && cargo run --release -p gpui-core --example bench_hot_paths
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo check --workspace --all-features
scripts.lint: oxlint --vue-plugin --deny-warnings packages/runtime/src packages/runtime/test packages/react/src packages/react/test packages/vue/src packages/vue/test examples web scripts vite.react-examples.config.mts vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --vue-plugin --fix packages/runtime/src packages/react/src packages/react/test packages/vue/src packages/vue/test examples web scripts vite.react-examples.config.mts vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts
scripts.test: bun run build:adapters && bun --filter @gpui-native/runtime test && bun --filter @gpui-native/vue test && bun --filter @gpui-native/react test && cargo test --workspace --all-features
scripts.test:native: bun run build:adapters && bun run scripts/native-smoke.mts && bun packages/vue/test/native-upstream.mts && bun packages/react/test/native-smoke.tsx
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:adapters && bun --filter @gpui-native/runtime typecheck && bun --filter @gpui-native/react typecheck && bun --filter @gpui-native/vue typecheck && bun --filter '@gpui-*/example-*' typecheck && bun packages/vue/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:adapters: bun --filter @gpui-native/runtime build && bun --filter @gpui-native/vue build && bun --filter @gpui-native/react build
scripts.test:wgpu: bun run build:adapters && bun --filter @gpui-native/runtime test:wgpu && bun packages/runtime/test/native-wgpu-lifecycle.mts && bun packages/runtime/test/native-webgpu-window.mts
